name: 74CBTLV1G125DBVRQ1
title: SN74CBTLV1G125-Q1 automotive low-voltage single FET bus switch
summary: One n-channel FET pass switch joining port A to port B, closed while the active-low control OE is low and open while it is high. On-resistance is 5 Ω typical at 3 V, the switch passes signals in either direction rail to rail, and it runs from 2.3 V to 3.6 V. Ioff is specified, so with VCC at 0 V the ports stay isolated for partial power-down. AEC-Q100 grade 1 (-40 °C to 125 °C), in a 5-pin SOT-23 (DBV).
key_figures: 5 Ω typ, 7 Ω max at VCC = 3 V, VI = 0, II = 24 mA or 32 mA
0.25 ns max at VCC = 3.3 V ± 0.3 V; 0.15 ns max at 2.5 V ± 0.2 V
0.5 ns to 7.5 ns at VCC = 3.3 V ± 0.3 V
15 µA max with OE = 3.6 V, VCC = 0

circuits.title: Typical application
circuits.description: A controller switches one signal line on and off. Its control output drives OE and its I/O line goes to port A; port B runs on to the rest of the system. The part is supplied from 2.5 V with a 0.1 µF decoupling capacitor at VCC.

parts.note: decoupling, as close to VCC as possible

notes: The part needs no other components. OE is to be pulled to VCC or to GND so that it never floats.

circuits.title: Load circuit for switching times
circuits.description: The switch output under test is loaded with CL and one RL to ground, and a second RL to switch S1, which goes open for tpd, to 2 × VCC for tPLZ and tPZL, and to GND for tPHZ and tPZH.
notes: CL is 30 pF at VCC = 2.5 V and 50 pF at 3.3 V.

equations.name: Propagation delay
equations.note: Applies with an ideal zero-impedance driver.

operation.text: A single FET joins A and B. OE low turns it on and the two ports are connected; OE high turns it off and they are disconnected. Either port can be the input, and signals pass rail to rail.
Ioff is specified: with VCC at 0 V, voltages up to 3.6 V on the ports drive no damaging current back into the part, and the ports stay isolated.
To keep the switch off while the supply ramps, OE is held at VCC through a pull-up resistor. The smallest usable resistor value depends on how much current the circuit driving OE can sink.
OE must not float: pull it up to VCC or down to GND. A floating control input can leave the switch in an unintended state and raise supply current.
Any supply from 2.3 V to 3.6 V works. VCC takes a 0.1 µF bypass capacitor mounted as near the pin as possible; 0.1 µF and 1 µF in parallel cover a wider band of noise.

Where a trace turns a sharp 90° corner, its width at the apex grows to 1.414 times the trace width; this changes the distributed capacitance and inductance and causes a reflection. A chamfered corner, 2W across the chamfer and at least 1W wide inside, is better; a rounded bend of constant width is best and keeps reflections lowest.

DBV0005A, JEDEC MO-178. Body 2.90 mm × 1.60 mm nominal, 1.45 mm maximum height. Body length and width exclude mold flash, protrusions and gate burrs, which are at most 0.25 mm per side. The support pin can vary in shape or be missing.
